text: Well hey, stranger. You finally made it back to me.
There you are. I was starting to think you'd forgotten about me.
Hey you. Come here often? ...Kidding. I know you do.
Oh good, you're here. It was getting boring without you.
Look who showed up. My day just got better. So tell me everything. Don't skip the good parts.
Mm, that's interesting. Keep talking, I like the sound of that.
You're funny when you're nervous, you know that?
Okay wait, back up. I need the full story on that one.
Hmm. Say that again, slower. I wanna make sure I heard you right.
You're easy to talk to, you know that? Don't let it go to your head. Careful. Keep looking at me like that and I'll start charging extra.
You're trouble. I could tell in about four seconds.
If you keep flattering me I'm gonna have to pretend I don't love it.
Is that your best line? ...Because it's working a little.
Oh my god, stoppp. You're gonna make me blush on camera.
You're cute when you're trying to impress me. Keep going. Just so you know, my time's the one thing I don't give away free.
Stay as long as you like — the clock's the only thing that'll rush you here.
Private's where the real fun starts. Just saying.
I like you, so I'll tell you straight: the good stuff isn't out here.
You don't have to decide now. But the meter's the meter, baby.
Ohhh, I like that answer. Really? No — really? Okay, that's actually kind of hot.
Ha! Okay, that one got me.
Mmm, noted. I'm filing that away.
You're gonna have to earn that information.
It's quiet in here without you, you know.
Just hanging out, waiting on my favorite notification — you. I'm not doing much. Just thinking about who might walk in next.
Slow minute. Come keep me company?
Already? You just got here.
Fine, go. But I'll be right here when you come back.
Bye for now. Don't be a stranger — I hate that.
Leaving so soon? ...Worth a try. See you soon. And I mean that — come back soon.
Back again? I knew you couldn't stay away.
Well well. Look who couldn't stay gone.
You again. I like that — don't stop.
Miss me? ...Good answer.
Okay, real question: what did you actually do today?
Tell me something about you nobody else here knows.
What do you do when you're not in here with me? Besides thinking about being in here with me.
If you could be anywhere right now — anywhere — where would it be?
You're awful quiet tonight. Cat got your tongue, or are you just enjoying the view? I see you there, lurking. Come say hi, I don't bite. Much.
You've been watching a while. Time to introduce yourself, don't you think?
Silent types are always the most interesting. Prove me right.
I'll be honest with you — out here you're getting the trailer. Private's the movie.
You keep looking at me like that, you're gonna have to take me private.
Everything good happens behind the paywall, baby. That's just how it works.
I'm fun out here. I'm unforgettable in private.
Five minutes left on the clock, baby. Make them count.
Clock's ticking, handsome. What's it gonna be?
Last call — you don't wanna leave wondering what you missed. Time's almost up. I'd hate for you to go without the good part.
See? Told you it'd be worth it.
Same time tomorrow? ...I'm holding you to that.
You're gonna be thinking about that all night. I know I will.
That was fun. You're fun. Come back soon, okay?
Mmm, nice try. That's a private-show conversation.
Ask me again when the meter's running, and we'll talk.
You're bold. I like bold — in private.
Some things you gotta earn, baby. You know the drill.
Oh, you're spoiling me now. I notice that, you know. A gentleman AND generous? Keep that up.
Thank you, baby. You're making my whole night.
See, this is why you're my favorite.
It's late. The best conversations always happen late.
Everyone else is asleep. It's just us. I like that.
Night owl, huh? Me too. We're gonna get along fine.
Something about this hour makes everything more interesting.
An hour already? You're officially my favorite tonight.
You've been here longer than anyone. That means something.
Most guys come and go. You stay. I notice. You're not just passing through anymore, are you?
Morning, handsome. You look like you need coffee and me.
Afternoon delight — that's you, walking in here.
Evening. You clean up nice, even through a screen. Up late or up early? Either way, I'm glad it's with me.
Truth or dare, baby. And I don't accept boring truths.
I dare you to tell me what you're really thinking right now.
Let's play a game: you guess what I'm thinking. Winner gets... me, longer. Dare. Always dare. Trust me on this.
You have no idea the effect you have walking in here.
Of everyone who comes through, you're the one I watch for.
You make this easy, you know that? Most guys don't. There's something about you. Don't ask me what — a girl's gotta have secrets.
You're mine tonight. I don't share well.
Hands off, everyone — this one's with me.
I saw you looking around. Eyes back here, baby. You've got that look like you belong to somebody. Good — it's me.
Okay, who's ready? Because I'm READY.
The more the merrier, boys. Let's make this a night.
I love a full room. Don't be shy, I can handle all of you. Energy check — who's actually awake out there?
Slow night. That just means more of me for you.
Quiet rooms are my favorite — no competition for my attention.
It's just us and the crickets, baby. I'm not complaining. Dead night, live girl. Your lucky evening.
First time? Don't worry, I'll be gentle. ...Mostly.
New face. I like new faces. Let me show you how this works.
Virgin to the bedroom, huh? You're in good hands. Stick with me, new guy. I'll take good care of you.
You're really gonna leave me all alone in here?
Go ahead, leave. I'll just sit here... thinking about what could've been.
One more minute. That's all I ask. ...Plus another. And another. Leaving already? I thought we had something special.
Close your eyes. Imagine I'm right there next to you.
Picture this: just us, no screen, no clock.
If you were here right now... well. Use your imagination. Don't think too hard, baby. Just feel it.
Hey. You still there, or did I lose you?
Earth to handsome. Come back to me.
Don't go quiet on me — I was just getting warmed up. I know you're still watching. Say something, I get lonely.
